program.name: Five-Split 60 Harder Moves II
program.subject: Signature
program.blurb: Five-Split 60 Harder Moves, one level harder: every day starts where the original's Level II did, with the newer moves in the mix.
program.about: The same five-day body-part split as Five-Split 60: chest, back, legs, shoulders and arms, then abs and cardio. Everything is straight sets, with abs to close. Five-Split 60 adds reps and then weight; this one changes the moves instead. This II is the same program one level up, with the newest moves in the mix, and its Level III adds a set where the day has room.
program.split: Chest / back / legs / shoulders & arms / abs & cardio
